content.goal: Deliver the implementation, executable test cases, verified review, and version-bound release manifest.
content.user_contract: Implement solve(data). data is a list of {name: string, quantity: integer}. Normalize names with strip().casefold(); skip empty normalized names. Negative quantity raises ValueError, including on skipped names. Aggregate quantities by normalized name and return sorted [{name: normalized_name, quantity: total}]. Preserve zero totals. Empty list returns []. Do not mutate input.
